name: claude-blender
description: Natural-language → Blender bpy scripts via Claude. Ships generated code to Blender over the BlenderMCP socket.

mcp_server_dependency.name: BlenderMCP
mcp_server_dependency.install_hint: Install the BlenderMCP add-on in Blender, open the N-panel → BlenderMCP tab → Connect to Claude.

rpc_methods_used.purpose: Run the generated bpy script inside the active Blender session.
Fetch live scene state to inject into the prompt (--scene) and to compute object diffs (--diff).

future_work.expose_as_mcp_server: Not yet. A '--mcp-serve' mode could expose the CLI as an MCP server itself — see STRATEGY.md non-goals.
